description: T-3424: Excel's FV (annuity value) along the model's RATE secant trace on the 16 noise-floor cells of probes-numeric/t3348-rate-gate-a-sweep (A272, A296) and t3348-rate-gate-a-fresh (A59, A70, A74, A77, A89, A90, A95, A157, A162, A173, A251, A272, A275, A292), whose type (number or #NUM!) the engine gets wrong. Each FV row reads Excel's annuity value pv*P + pmt*A at one iterate of the model's run from guess 0.1 (residual = fv - FV); the first 6 and last 24 distinct iterates are kept. Each iterate is written as (a+b), a 15-digit head and a tail, because Excel cuts a formula literal to 15 significant digits and the sum rounds back to the iterate's double. On the nper 1 and 2 cells, RATE seeded with each of the last 12 iterates as its guess reads Excel's run from that point. Generator: docs/research/t3424/gen_trace_probe.py.
